title: Move to rejoin EU among options for UK, says Burnham
description: The prime minister tells the BBC the current Brexit settlement has caused "more harm than good".

title: UK research funded by China front company being sent to Beijing's spies, MI5 warns
description: British universities are being urged to sever ties with China General Technology Research Institute which is linked to the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS).

title: Watch: Detail about new call to police changes RAF Fairford timeline
description: One of five men arrested near RAF Fairford in the early hours of Sunday morning had dialled 999 himself, the BBC understands. BBC's UK correspondent Daniel Sandford explains the timeline of events.

title: Sussexes condemn 'reckless intrusion' after men spotted near Archie and Lilibet's school
description: One of the men seen outside the UK school attended by the children is understood to be an international press photographer.

title: Guardiola backing Man City after guilty verdicts
description: Former manager Pep Guardiola says he will "always" be behind Manchester City after they were found guilty of all charges related to breaches of the Premier League's financial rules.

title: Rock, paper, scissors used to decide London Marathon race days for elite runners
description: A game of rock, paper, scissors is used to determine when the elite female and male races will take place at next year's two-day London Marathon.

title: Police seek charges against 20 firms and 54 people over Grenfell Tower fire
description: The force is seeking charges against 54 individuals and 20 companies over the 2017 tower block fire that killed 72 people.

title: Greggs to shut four factories and cut 740 jobs
description: The company says it needs to "keep evolving alongside changing customer expectations".

title: Grooming gangs inquiry expanded to Birmingham and Wales
description: Targeted investigations will be carried out as part of a national inquiry into child sexual abuse.
